title: Kyōto Station
visualBrief: The Isetan and Granvia wings flank an open atrium under a curved steel and glass canopy. The Grand Staircase rises 35 metres to the west terrace, with a suspended Skyway and tiered galleries above the entrance hall. The Hachijō frontage encloses the raised Shinkansen decks and connects to the mapped platform sheds.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry built from photo observations, attributed map alignment and standard terrain samples.
materialMethod: Six shared graphs cover concrete, panel concrete, standing-seam roofing, painted steel, granite and tinted glazing. A local translucent material covers the atrium and guards. The spaceframe, staircase, Skyway and curtain-wall grid use geometry.
limitations: The podium, outer building wings, rail centerlines and platform shelter footprints follow PMTiles. Photo interpretation supplies the atrium section, public circulation and individual facade bays.
The forecourt elevations follow open Terrarium approach samples. The station floors and railway deck elevations are reconstructed to bridge high samples over the built site.
The model represents the exterior, the public atrium and the above-ground track concourses. Stairs, escalators and railway fixtures are static geometry.
